UpdateSourceArgs: -NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://github.com/SteamRE/DepotDownloader/releases/download/DepotDownloader_3.4.0/DepotDownloader-windows-x64.zip' -OutFile 'depotdownloader.zip'; if ($?) { Write-Output 'DepotDownloader 3.4.0 downloaded' } else { exit 1 }"

-c "chmod +x csgo/depotdownloader/DepotDownloader && DepotUser='{{DepotSteamUsername}}' && DepotPass='{{DepotSteamPassword}}' && LoginArgs=() && if [[ -n \"$DepotUser\" ]]; then LoginArgs=(-username \"$DepotUser\" -remember-password); if [[ -n \"$DepotPass\" ]]; then LoginArgs+=(-password \"$DepotPass\"); fi; fi; ./csgo/depotdownloader/DepotDownloader -app 740 -depot 731 -manifest 1726760845998127111 -dir csgo/740 \"${LoginArgs[@]}\" && [[ -f csgo/740/.DepotDownloader/731_1726760845998127111.manifest ]] && ./csgo/depotdownloader/DepotDownloader -app 740 -depot 740 -manifest 9121620377426899826 -dir csgo/740 \"${LoginArgs[@]}\" && [[ -f csgo/740/.DepotDownloader/740_9121620377426899826.manifest ]] && echo \"CS:GO March 2018 depots 731 and 740 installed\" || { echo \"CS:GO March 2018 depot download failed\"; exit 1; }"

-NoProfile -Command "$DepotUser='{{DepotSteamUsername}}'; $DepotPass='{{DepotSteamPassword}}'; $LoginArgs=@(); if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($DepotUser)) { $LoginArgs += @('-username', $DepotUser, '-remember-password'); if (-not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($DepotPass)) { $LoginArgs += @('-password', $DepotPass) } }; foreach ($Pair in @(@('731','1726760845998127111'), @('740','9121620377426899826'))) { & '.\csgo\depotdownloader\DepotDownloader.exe' -app 740 -depot $Pair[0] -manifest $Pair[1] -dir 'csgo\740' @LoginArgs; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not (Test-Path ('csgo\740\.DepotDownloader\' + $Pair[0] + '_' + $Pair[1] + '.manifest'))) { Write-Output ('CS:GO March 2018 depot ' + $Pair[0] + ' download failed'); exit 1 } }; Write-Output 'CS:GO March 2018 depots 731 and 740 installed'"

-c "MetamodBuild=\"{{MetamodBuild}}\" && MetamodBranch=\"{{ModBranch}}\" && if [[ -z \"$MetamodBuild\" ]]; then wget -qO metamod.tar.gz \"https://metamodsource.net/latest.php?os=linux&version=$MetamodBranch\" && echo \"Latest Metamod $MetamodBranch build downloaded\" && exit 0; elif [[ ! \"$MetamodBuild\" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then echo \"Invalid Metamod build version format specified\" && exit 1; fi; if { [[ \"$MetamodBranch\" == \"2.0\" ]] && [[ \"$MetamodBuild\" -ge 1391 ]]; } || { [[ \"$MetamodBranch\" == \"1.12\" ]] && [[ \"$MetamodBuild\" -ge 1221 ]]; }; then DownloadURL=\"https://github.com/alliedmodders/metamod-source/releases/download/$MetamodBranch.0.$MetamodBuild/mmsource-$MetamodBranch.0-git$MetamodBuild-linux.tar.gz\"; else FileName=$(wget -qO- \"https://mms.alliedmods.net/mmsdrop/$MetamodBranch/\" | grep -oE \"mmsource-$MetamodBranch\.[0-9]+-git$MetamodBuild-linux\.tar\.gz\" | head -n 1); if [[ -z \"$FileName\" ]]; then echo \"Metamod $MetamodBranch build $MetamodBuild not found\" && exit 1; fi; DownloadURL=\"https://mms.alliedmods.net/mmsdrop/$MetamodBranch/$FileName\"; fi; wget -qO metamod.tar.gz \"$DownloadURL\" && echo \"Metamod $MetamodBranch build $MetamodBuild downloaded\""

-NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; $MetamodBuild='{{MetamodBuild}}'; $MetamodBranch='{{ModBranch}}'; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($MetamodBuild)) { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri \"https://metamodsource.net/latest.php?os=windows&version=$MetamodBranch\" -OutFile 'metamod.zip'; if ($?) { Write-Output \"Latest Metamod $MetamodBranch build downloaded\"; exit 0 } } elseif ($MetamodBuild -notmatch '^\d+$') { Write-Output \"Invalid Metamod build version format specified\"; exit 1 }; if (($MetamodBranch -eq '2.0' -and [int]$MetamodBuild -ge 1391) -or ($MetamodBranch -eq '1.12' -and [int]$MetamodBuild -ge 1221)) { $DownloadURL = \"https://github.com/alliedmodders/metamod-source/releases/download/$MetamodBranch.0.$MetamodBuild/mmsource-$MetamodBranch.0-git$MetamodBuild-windows.zip\" } else { $Listing = (Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri \"https://mms.alliedmods.net/mmsdrop/$MetamodBranch/\").Content; $FileName = [regex]::Match($Listing, \"mmsource-$MetamodBranch\.\d+-git$MetamodBuild-windows\.zip\").Value; if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($FileName)) { Write-Output \"Metamod $MetamodBranch build $MetamodBuild not found\"; exit 1 }; $DownloadURL = \"https://mms.alliedmods.net/mmsdrop/$MetamodBranch/$FileName\" }; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri $DownloadURL -OutFile 'metamod.zip'; if ($?) { Write-Output \"Metamod $MetamodBranch build $MetamodBuild downloaded\" }"

-c "SourceModBuild=\"{{SourceModVersion}}\" && SourceModBranch=\"{{SourceModBranch}}\" && if [[ -z \"$SourceModBuild\" ]]; then wget -qO sourcemod.tar.gz \"https://sourcemod.net/latest.php?os=linux&version=$SourceModBranch\" && echo \"Latest SourceMod $SourceModBranch build downloaded\" && exit 0; elif [[ ! \"$SourceModBuild\" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then echo \"Invalid SourceMod build version format specified\" && exit 1; fi; if { [[ \"$SourceModBranch\" == \"1.13\" ]] && [[ \"$SourceModBuild\" -ge 7311 ]]; } || { [[ \"$SourceModBranch\" == \"1.12\" ]] && [[ \"$SourceModBuild\" -ge 7225 ]]; }; then DownloadURL=\"https://github.com/alliedmodders/sourcemod/releases/download/$SourceModBranch.0.$SourceModBuild/sourcemod-$SourceModBranch.0-git$SourceModBuild-linux.tar.gz\"; else DownloadURL=\"https://sm.alliedmods.net/smdrop/$SourceModBranch/sourcemod-$SourceModBranch.0-git$SourceModBuild-linux.tar.gz\"; fi; wget -qO sourcemod.tar.gz \"$DownloadURL\" && echo \"SourceMod $SourceModBranch build $SourceModBuild downloaded\""

-NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; $SourceModBuild='{{SourceModVersion}}'; $SourceModBranch='{{SourceModBranch}}'; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($SourceModBuild)) { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri \"https://sourcemod.net/latest.php?os=windows&version=$SourceModBranch\" -OutFile 'sourcemod.zip'; if ($?) { Write-Output \"Latest SourceMod $SourceModBranch build downloaded\"; exit 0 } } elseif ($SourceModBuild -notmatch '^\d+$') { Write-Output \"Invalid SourceMod build version format specified\"; exit 1 }; if (($SourceModBranch -eq '1.13' -and [int]$SourceModBuild -ge 7311) -or ($SourceModBranch -eq '1.12' -and [int]$SourceModBuild -ge 7225)) { $DownloadURL = \"https://github.com/alliedmodders/sourcemod/releases/download/$SourceModBranch.0.$SourceModBuild/sourcemod-$SourceModBranch.0-git$SourceModBuild-windows.zip\" } else { $DownloadURL = \"https://sm.alliedmods.net/smdrop/$SourceModBranch/sourcemod-$SourceModBranch.0-git$SourceModBuild-windows.zip\" }; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri $DownloadURL -OutFile 'sourcemod.zip'; if ($?) { Write-Output \"SourceMod $SourceModBranch build $SourceModBuild downloaded\" }"

-NoProfile -Command "Set-Location -Path 'csgo/740'; if (Test-Path 'csgo/cfg/sourcemod') { Remove-Item -Path 'sm/cfg/sourcemod' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null }; if (Test-Path 'csgo/addons/sourcemod/configs') { Remove-Item -Path 'sm/addons/sourcemod/configs' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null }; if (Test-Path 'csgo/addons/sourcemod/plugins') { Remove-Item -Path 'sm/addons/sourcemod/plugins' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null }; Copy-Item -Path 'sm/*' -Destination 'csgo' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null; Remove-Item -Path 'sm' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null"

-c "cd csgo/740 && [ -d csgo/cfg/sourcemod ] && rm -rf sm/cfg/sourcemod >/dev/null 2>&1; [ -d csgo/addons/sourcemod/configs ] && rm -rf sm/addons/sourcemod/configs >/dev/null 2>&1; [ -d csgo/addons/sourcemod/plugins ] && rm -rf sm/addons/sourcemod/plugins >/dev/null 2>&1; \cp -rf sm/* csgo/ >/dev/null 2>&1; rm -rf sm >/dev/null 2>&1"
